questions.question: Police complaints can only be made by writing to the Chief Constable of the police force involved.
questions.explanation: False. Anyone can make a complaint about the police by going to a police station and writing to the Chief Constable of the police force involved. Complaints can also be made to an independent body: the Independent Police Complaints Commission in England and Wales, the Police Complaints Commissioner for Scotland or the Police Ombudsman for Northern Ireland.
questions.handbook_locator: Chapter 5: The UK government, the law and your role

learning.why_correct_en: False. Anyone can make a complaint about the police by going to a police station and writing to the Chief Constable of the police force involved. Complaints can also be made to an independent body: the Independent Police Complaints Commission in England and Wales, the Police Complaints Commissioner for Scotland or the Police Ombudsman for Northern Ireland.
learning.why_correct_zh:
这个说法是错误的，因为写信给Chief Constable并不是唯一的投诉方式。Chief Constable是地方警队的最高级警官；投诉实际通常由警队的Professional Standards Department（专业标准部门）处理，并非由Chief Constable本人逐一处理。

以英格兰和威尔士为例，可以通过警队网站、101电话、前往警察局或书面方式投诉，也可以使用IOPC的表格；IOPC一般会把投诉转给相关警队。警队随后评估并记录投诉，最严重的案件必须转交IOPC。处理结果通知会说明能否申请review（复核），通常须在28天内提出。
learning.source_note_zh: 官方教材是答案和考试范围的主要依据；其他权威来源用于补充该主题背景。

visual.alt_zh: 根据题目“Police complaints can only be made by writing to the Chief Constable of the police force involved.”及正确答案“False”生成的AI学习插图。

questions.question: Northern Ireland and Scotland have their own banknotes, which are valid everywhere in the UK.
questions.explanation: This statement is true.
questions.handbook_locator: Chapter 4: A modern, thriving society

learning.why_correct_en: Authorised banks in Scotland and Northern Ireland issue genuine pound sterling notes that may circulate throughout the UK. They are not legal tender everywhere, however, and an individual business may decide which forms of payment it accepts.
learning.why_correct_zh:
本题答案是True。苏格兰和北爱尔兰获授权的银行都可以发行自己的英镑纸币，这些纸币代表pound sterling，可在英国各地使用。

不过它们不是legal tender，商家可以拒收。因此“valid everywhere”表示它们是有效货币，并不表示每家商店都必须接受。

questions.question: During which period did the Beatles become popular and social laws were liberalised?
questions.explanation: The decade of the 1960s was a period of significant social change. It was known as the ‘swinging sixties’. There was growth in British fashion, cinema and popular music. Two well-known pop music groups at the time were The Beatles and The Rolling Stones. It was also a time when social laws were liberalised, for example in relation to divorce and to abortion in England, Wales and Scotland. The position of women in the workplace also improved.

questions.question: What is the Turner Prize?
questions.explanation: The Turner Prize was established in 1984 and celebrates contemporary art. The Turner Prize is recognised as one of the most prestigious visual art awards in Europe.
